description.value: The study examined how instructed causal attributions regulate positive and negative emotions and their neural correlates in patients with major depressive disorder and healthy controls using task fMRI and resting-state functional connectivity.

spans.text: The current study therefore aimed to examine how instructed causal attributions of positive and negative events affect the emotional experience of depressed individuals as well as its neural bases.
